VinCheck.metaTitle: VIN check in Latvia | how a car history check works | PROVIN
VinCheck.metaDescription: VIN check before you buy a used car: what a VIN is, what a car history report shows, and why you also need a listing audit, not just a data printout.
VinCheck.h1: VIN check before you buy a car
VinCheck.lead: A VIN is a 17-character factory identification number. It lets us gather register data and service history, and find contradictions in the listing. PROVIN does not just give you a data printout: we compare the sources and explain what they mean for this particular car.
VinCheck.whatBody: A VIN check is a car history check based on the identification number. It covers mileage, road accidents, theft, register records and, where available, official dealer service history. It is not the same as a single PDF from one database. Data from different sources may only partly agree, and the listing photos often tell you more than the figures in a table.
VinCheck.whyTitle: Why is one car history report not enough?
VinCheck.whyBody: Each report shows only what was found in one particular database, and data from different databases often differs considerably. We combine information from several databases in one overview. On top of the VIN check, we also assess the listing and the weak points of the specific model. If you have a link to the listing, be sure to add it to your order.
VinCheck.howTitle: How a check works at PROVIN
VinCheck.howBody: Enter the VIN or licence plate number on the home page, choose the MINI or AUDITS package and add the listing link if you have one. MINI is better suited to cars that have been registered in Latvia for several years. AUDITS is an in-depth check for any car, including those imported into Latvia: international databases, dealer systems and auction archives, where available. You will usually receive the result within 24-72 hours, and a short consultation is available after the report.
VinCheck.findBody: A VIN has 17 characters. You will usually find it in the lower left corner of the windscreen (seen from inside the car), on the driver's door frame or on the registration certificate. In a listing, the VIN is often in the description or one of the photos. If the listing has no VIN, ask the seller for it before you travel to view the car. A car history check is not possible without a VIN or licence plate number.
VinCheck.historyTitle: What a car history check means
VinCheck.historyBody: A car history check by VIN gathers what has been recorded about the specific car in registers and databases: mileage, road accidents, theft, changes in the country of registration and, where available, official dealer service records. This helps you spot contradictions with the listing. It is not the same as an in-person inspection or a workshop diagnosis. If a source has no data, we say so rather than making anything up.
VinCheck.vsDecoderTitle: VIN check and the free VIN decoder
VinCheck.vsDecoderBody: The free VIN decoder identifies the manufacturer, country and, for many makes, the model or year. It helps you check that the VIN in the listing matches the car. A VIN check and a car history check go further: registers, service history and listing analysis. The decoder is the first step. If the car is a serious candidate, the next step is MINI or AUDITS.
VinCheck.latviaTitle: A car registered in Latvia versus an import
VinCheck.latviaBody: If the car has been in Latvia for several years, local registers (CSDD, insurers, technical inspection) often tell you the essentials. MINI is usually enough in that case. If the car was imported recently, its local history is short. You then need foreign databases, dealer systems and auction archives, where available. That is what AUDITS does. We choose the set of sources based on the make and origin, not from one standard list for every car.
VinCheck.homeTitle: VIN check and car history check
VinCheck.homeBody: If you are looking for a VIN check or a car history check before you buy, start with our <freeEval>free VIN and listing assessment</freeEval>. We will send you a short comment, explain what the check includes and recommend the most suitable package.
VinCheck.homeMore: If you would like to understand the difference first, read our <vinPage>guide to VIN checks and car history checks</vinPage>.
VinCheck.homeHistoryCta: Car history check: what to know
VinCheck.decoderCrossLink: The decoder reads what is encoded in the VIN. A car history check by VIN is the next step if the car is a serious candidate.

VinDecoder.metaTitle: Free VIN decoder: manufacturer, country and year | PROVIN
VinDecoder.metaDescription: Free VIN decoder: manufacturer, country of manufacture and possible model year from the VIN. History, mileage and listing analysis in the PROVIN audit.
VinDecoder.title: VIN decoder
VinDecoder.lead: Check a car by its Latvian licence plate or 17-character VIN. Enter a plate to see CSDD data (make, model, year, engine, technical inspection) and the beginning of the VIN - compare it with the VIN in the listing to make sure it is genuine and belongs to this car. Enter a VIN to see the manufacturer, country and, for many makes, the model and year. Free, no sign-up.
VinDecoder.errLength: A VIN must be exactly 17 characters.
VinDecoder.errChars: A VIN never contains the letters I, O or Q. Please check what you entered.
VinDecoder.checkBad: Mismatch: possible typo or altered VIN
VinDecoder.yearHint: The 10th character repeats every 30 years; the correct year is determined from the car's appearance and documents.
VinDecoder.modelHint: The model comes from the manufacturer code in the VIN. One code can cover several models on the same platform, so all of them are listed.
VinDecoder.errPlate: Latvian plate: 2-3 letters and 1-4 digits, for example AB1234.

HomeFreeTools.lead: Start with a free check. Order the full audit only if the car is really worth it.
HomeFreeTools.vinBody: Enter a Latvian licence plate number to see the make, model, year, engine and technical inspection expiry date straight away. Enter a VIN to see the manufacturer, country of origin and, for many makes, the model and year. Free, no sign-up.
HomeFreeTools.listingTitle: Send us a listing to review
HomeFreeTools.listingBody: We review the listing through the eyes of an experienced buyer: the description, the photos and any contradictions we spot. We email you our findings and comments - completely free of charge.
HomeFreeTools.askBody: Not sure which report suits you best? Wondering whether a car from the UK, USA or Japan can be checked? Write to us and we will be happy to advise.
